space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

principal.description: The principal whose records are erased, <kind>:<id> (human:corp/U019488227, agent:loopback)

ids.description: Only these of the principal's records, by id; default: every record they own in the space, whoever may read it

dryRun.description: true: count the records and compute the plan, erasing nothing (required first); false: erase, presenting the plan

plan.description: The plan the dry run gave (sha256: and 64 hex digits); required when dryRun is false

request.description: With erase_approvals = 2: the erase request (x- and 20 hex digits) a second eraser approves
